issue.title: Refresh stale contract manifest and re-curate its entry budget
issue.description: Discovered while verifying task-launch prompt changes on 2026-08-10 at origin/master 9fddbbe77 plus only the local bd/work_task/#commit prompt/doc diff. 'just check' escalated to the full non-visual suite and failed tests/test_contract_manifest.py::{test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection,test_contract_set_manifest_entry_budget_has_no_hidden_headroom}. Focused prompt-change suites passed, so this is unrelated to the task-launch prompt change. Reproduction: run 'just test tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_set_manifest_entry_budget_has_no_hidden_headroom'. Failure evidence: marker selection now includes tests/test_probe_core_floor_tool.py that is missing from tests/contract_manifest.txt, and the checked-in manifest contains 38 entries while _MANIFEST_ENTRY_BUDGET remains 36; pytest reports entries over budget ['tests/test_validate_test_environment_tool.py', 'tests/test_xprompt_workflow_schema.py']. Scope: refresh the stale manifest and intentionally re-curate the contract set or update the budget/measured-cost comment per plans/202608/test_suite_tier1.md so the contract-manifest guard is green and meaningful.
